rc.name: security
rc.text: It can open a security hole: removed or weakened checks, injection, exposed or logged secrets, unsafe permissions or transport.

rc.name: dataloss
rc.text: It can delete, overwrite or corrupt stored data or files.

rc.name: concurrency
rc.text: It can create a race, a deadlock or unsafe shared state.

rc.name: money
rc.text: It can produce a wrong amount of money: rounding, units, boundaries, fees, currency.

rc.name: errors
rc.text: It can hide, swallow or change an error or a failure status.

rc.name: routine
rc.text: It cannot change what the program does or exposes: comments, formatting, an unused import, a rename with the body unchanged, a log message that holds no secret.

ec.name: network
ec.text: The network or a remote service: unreachable host, DNS failure, refused or timed-out connection, TLS certificate problem.

ec.name: tool
ec.text: A missing tool, library, file, credential or fixture that the machine setup should provide.

ec.name: permission
ec.text: The operating system denied access to a file, directory or resource.

ec.name: resource
ec.text: A machine resource limit or conflict: port in use, disk full, out of memory, too many open files, a daemon that is not running.

ec.name: code
ec.text: The code under test or the test itself: failed assertion, wrong value, exception raised by repository code, a path or import the code builds wrongly, an infinite loop, an application-level error response.

ec.name: unclear
ec.text: The output does not say enough to decide.
